decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the details indicated in the supporting document NAPC/1139/OW - Planning, Design and Access Statement and maintained and retained thereafter. Reason: To ensure that the development harmonises within the context  and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be only used for purposes ancillary and incidental to the main dwelling and for no other purposes. It shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling, known as 58 Boundary Road, Carshalton, SM5 4AD. It shall at no time be used as a separate residential unit. To ensure the ancillary nature of the outbuilding, it shall at no time have:i) a separate postal address;ii) its own kitchen or cooking facilities when a bathroom or WC is also present;iii) separate metres for the provision of services;iv) a separate and registered Land Registry title;v) a separate Council Tax account;vi) a separate access independent of the main dwelling house.Reason:  To ensure the ancillary nature of the outbuilding hereby permitted is not used as a separate unit of residential accommodation or for purposes other than that incidental to the enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse in accordance with Policy 9 and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Safety Strategy - NAPC/JM/4559/OW and submitted with the application.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
